meter.note: DLP projectors pulse their light: use a FIXED range above the pulse peaks and the low-pass filter ON. 2026-10-20 on omnifin0: auto range settled at 17.8 uW full scale and clipped white to 116 uW (true ~323 uW); fixed 1.78 mW and 17.8 mW ranges with low-pass ON agreed on white (323.7 vs 323.3 uW); 1.78 mW gives better precision on dim grays.

notes: Lay the S130VC flat, face down onto the light, on the arena crosshair; nothing else on the shelf.
Readings are at the film plane, not the fish plane.
